final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Only currencyservice-7595dc65b4-ks62n is an outlier in the pods listing: RESTARTS 2 (25s ago) while all other 10 pods show RESTARTS 0. Pod detail shows Last State Terminated, Reason Error, Exit Code 137 (not OOMKilled) with pod events: Warning Unhealthy 'Liveness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.175:7000/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x00\x04..."' (x9 over 81s) and Normal Killing 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (x3). The returned bytes are HTTP/2 frame headers, i.e. kubelet probes a gRPC/HTTP2-only port with HTTP/1.x. GetAppYAML(currencyservice) confirms the defect: container port is named grpc on 7000, readinessProbe correctly uses 'grpc: port: 7000', but livenessProbe uses 'httpGet: path / port 7000' - so the port, path and timing (delay 5s / timeout 1s / period 10s / failure 3) are correct and the protocol is wrong. GetErrorLogs(currencyservice) returned no error logs and GetAlerts() showed no metric anomalies, confirming the restart loop is driven by the probe, not by application errors or resource saturation. Pod never reaches a successful liveness check, so kubelet kills and recreates it repeatedly (restart count 2 within 90s of pod age).
